faq.q: What is Rideout Customs in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rideout Customs is a vehicle customization shop confirmed as part of the Ultimate Edition content. Rockstar describes it as offering detailed interiors, custom rims and donk stylings.

faq.q: What kind of customisation does Rideout Customs offer?
faq.a: Detailed interiors, custom rims and donk-style modifications, according to Rockstar. Promotional imagery shows rims with Ace of Spades-shaped cutouts, glitter paintwork and a red speckled interior.

faq.q: Can Standard Edition owners visit Rideout Customs in GTA 6?
faq.a: No. Standard Edition owners cannot access Rideout Customs unless they purchase the Ultimate Edition upgrade, since it is confirmed Ultimate Edition exclusive content.

faq.q: How is Rideout Customs different from One-Eyed Willie's?
faq.a: Rideout Customs focuses on donk-style street customisation, while One-Eyed Willie's specializes in off-road vehicles with hand-painted custom art. Both are separate confirmed Ultimate Edition mod shops.

faq.q: Where is Rideout Customs located in GTA 6?
faq.a: The record does not specify an exact neighborhood for Rideout Customs. It only confirms the shop as part of the Ultimate Edition bundle alongside four other Vice City area storefronts.
